help.title: ヘルプ
help.lead: よくある質問と、その場で実行できるボタン。
help.privacy_a: 音声認識と話者の判別は端末上のモデルで動きます。ネットワークを切っても録音と文字起こしは動作します。要約・翻訳・質問応答は言語モデルを呼び出し、その接続先は設定で選べます。Ollama を選べば内容は端末に残り、外部 API を選べばその API に送られます。
help.record_q: Do I need a bot in the meeting?
help.record_a: No. Summo captures the microphone and the system audio on your own machine, so it works with Zoom, Meet, Teams, a phone call, or people in a room — anything your computer can hear. Press record, talk, press stop.
help.models_q: What is a model, and which do I need?
help.models_a: The model is the part that listens and writes words. Start with the one the Models screen recommends: it measures your machine and says which will keep up with live audio. Install a larger one later if you want a more accurate pass after the meeting.
help.files_a: In ~/.summo/vault, as ordinary Markdown. Open it in Obsidian, grep it, put it in git, back it up. Summo reads those same files back, so editing them elsewhere is fine. Recordings live in ~/.summo/audio and you set how long they are kept.
help.assistant_q: What does the assistant answer from?
help.assistant_a: Only what is in your vault. Every answer carries a citation pointing at the meeting and the timestamp it came from; click it and you land there to check. If the vault does not contain the answer, it says so.
help.translate_q: Can it translate, and does that need the network?
help.translate_a: Yes, 46 languages, on a model inside the app — no Ollama, no network. Translate as you record from Settings; translate a recording you already have from the “Export & translate” card on the meeting.
help.shortcuts_a: Press ? anywhere for the full list. The two worth remembering: ⌘K (Ctrl+K) searches and jumps to anything, and ⌘⇧R starts and stops recording even when the window is hidden.
help.stuck_q: Recording will not start, or something failed
help.stuck_a: Three places, in order: Settings › Recording for the microphone permission and the device; Models to check a speech model is installed; Settings › Intelligence and “Test connection” if the failure was about summarising or asking. If it still will not go, report it with the sentence the app showed you.
